## Experience that connects research and delivery

Andrea earned a doctorate in physics and astrophysics from the University of Milan. He has worked at
the San Diego Supercomputer Center since 2013, helping researchers use high-performance computing
resources and teaching Python for high-performance computing.

His work spans distributed data processing, scientific Python, cloud platforms, Kubernetes,
JupyterHub, and artificial intelligence workflows. This background is useful when a project needs
more than a generic software integration, including careful data handling, reproducible analysis,
performance testing, or custom model workflows.

::: {.ai-grid}
